pages.text: Automate your mob and crop farms. Industrial Foregoing brings mob farming, fluid automation and early bio-processing online at Tier 2.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() T2 opens the basic IF machines (Mob Crusher, Mob Duplicator, Animal Rancher, Plant Gatherer), which automate your material farming.$(br2)$(bold)T3 upgrade:$() The advanced IF features, the more powerful and complex machines, are T3 content. Basic mob and plant farms stay open at T2.
$(bold)Integration:$() IF's Fluid Crafter and Laser Drill become important when you prepare for Mekanism at T3. Plan a Laser Drill setup during T2 and you get a shortcut into T3.

$(bold)No book needed.$() JEI documents all of Industrial Foregoing, and every machine has a tooltip that explains what it does.$(br2)$(bold)Next: build a Mob Crusher farm.$() It is the T2 material engine, and it keeps paying into T3.
